title: Override no longer matches: Core interface method gained a parameter (CS0115) — update override and base call
problemSignature: CS0115: no suitable method found to override (Core virtual method gained a trailing parameter, e.g. GetBrowseListSubEntities(+User currentUser))

requiredRepoCharacteristics: client class derives from / overrides a Core service or repository

exclusions: Do not apply without decompiling the installed target DLL to confirm the signature.
rootCauseHypothesis: Core minor release changed a virtual/protected signature.
proposedActions: Decompile the installed Core class and read the new virtual signature.
Add the parameter to the client override and to the base.Method(...) call, keeping parameter order.
Rebuild; also check interface implementers/call sites.
